Headline: #21 Cermak Temporary Eastbound Reroute near 26th/Michigan
ShortDescription: Eastbound 21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted via Cermak, Michigan, 25th, and to layover, due to street blockage near 26th/Michigan.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted via Cermak, Michigan, 25th, and to layover, due to street blockage near 26th/Michigan.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #22 Clark and #152 Addison Temporary Reroute near Clark/Addison
ShortDescription: #22 Clark and #152 Addison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Clark/Addison.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#22 Clark and #152 Addison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Clark/Addison.

#22 Clark buses will operate via Clark, Racine, Belmont, then resume their normal route on Clark.

#152 Addison buses will operate via Addison, Racine, Belmont, Halsted, then resume their normal route on Addison.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Howard-bound Red Line trains bypassing Addison and Sheridan
ShortDescription: Howard-bound Red Line trains are running, but not stopping at Addison, due to track conditions.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Howard-bound Red Line trains are running, but not stopping at Addison due to track conditions.

As a result, where riders needing station Addison, can transfer to 95th-bound service and ride back to bypassed stops at Sheridan. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#8 Halsted

#22 Clark

#36 Broadway

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
